data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

Camunda is going through the AI-First transformation, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering Operations Team. As part of this high-impact platform team, you will play a key role in fostering engineering excellence by creating, implementing and maintaining scalable core processes to enhance development efficiency, reliability, and quality within the Camunda 8 code bases, as well as the Engineering-wide organization processes.

As Camunda 8 evolves into the leader of the agentic orchestration market, your mission is to ensure our internal development lifecycle is just as autonomous and gets us there in a frictionless manner. You will work with infrastructure and core software engineering teams to ensure smooth workflows, robust dependency management, and continuous improvement of CI processes in the era of AI-first development; enabling the Camunda 8 engineering teams to focus better on the core product development.

What you'll be doing

  • AI-Augmented Engineering: Lead the shift toward an automated engineering lifecycle by implementing and orchestrating unified processes in the Camunda 8 repos - including AI-assisted processes like release management, autonomous dependency updates, and proactive CVE remediation.
  • Continuously optimize CI/release health and development velocity using a metric-driven approach to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in our AI-first workflows
  • Collaborate with the key stakeholders to implement the CI strategy and engineering best practices, by creating a positive impact within the Engineering organization.
  • Identify friction points in engineering workflows and evolve them into automated, self-sustaining systems that can handle the increased volume of an AI-augmented workforce - by effectively partnering with software engineers, engineering leaders and cross-team stakeholders

What you bring:

Must Haves:

  • Strong Software Engineering experience with a track record of delivering results (preferably, in Java)
    • Specialization: Fullstack or Backend
  • Passion for engineering operational excellence beyond writing code, including CI/CD optimization, dependency management, release process enhancements, metrics collection, and build efficiency (DevOps mindset), and track record of owning and developing engineering processes end-to-end
  • Strong experience in CI build tools (GitHub Actions, Java ecosystem - Maven, Docker) and automations (Shell/Python) in complex projects (e.g. monorepositories)
  • Being a strong collaborator across teams and delivering impactful solutions in a platform-like environment.
  • Experience in developer experience tools and process optimization & driving AI adoption

You thrive in taking ownership of the codebase, as well as how you deploy and operate software. You are comfortable with the “you build it, you run it” mindset.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience designing efficient cross-team operations
  • Practical experience with Camunda or other BPMN systems

What We Have to Offer

Compensation

We offer fair, transparent, and competitive compensation. For new hires, we typically place candidates in the first half of the range, allowing room for growth over time.

Annual Total Cash (base salary + 100% variable, where applicable):

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00
  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00
  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

data.description:
The Role

This is an individual contributor role. Nobody reports to you. You sit in the TECH team, which builds and ships changes to our store and landing pages every week.

The Product Designer decides what a page is for and how it should feel. The creative lead owns the brand rules. The Senior Design Engineer owns the section kit and reviews your design and code. Within those, the layout and build decisions on your pages are yours. Engineers own checkout logic, data and release.

You will ship real pages to real customers from your first month. Small pages first, bigger formats as you grow.

Reporting line: Direct to the CTO.

The title means little. If your CV says Web Designer, Front-end Designer, UI Designer or Creative Developer, or you are self-taught with live work to show, apply.

What Will You Do?

  • Design and build. Turn a brief into a finished landing page or store section, in Figma and in code.
  • Ship variants. Build test variants fast from the section kit, so the team can learn what customers respond to.
  • Grow the kit. Add new sections to the kit in Figma and in code, with review from the Senior Design Engineer.
  • Stay on brand. Apply our typography, colour, photography and tone rules every time.
  • Design and build accessibly. Meet WCAG 2.1 AA in design and in code: semantic HTML, contrast, focus states, labels and alt text.
  • Ship with AI. Use AI to generate layouts, code and asset variations. Read what it gives you and fix it before review. Keep customer data out of unapproved tools.

Our Stack

  • Figma, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, React and Next.js on Vercel, our in-house tools for AI-generated landing pages, PostHog, GitHub and Linear.
  • Our AI tooling includes Claude, Codex and Figma AI.
  • You do not need to know every tool. A strong eye, clean HTML and CSS, and the ability to learn matter more than matching the list.

Skills & Qualifications

At least one year designing and building for the web, in a job, freelance or your own projects, with live pages you made yourself.

Essential

  • A good eye for layout, typography and visual hierarchy. Your portfolio shows taste.
  • Live web pages. You have designed and built pages that real people use.
  • HTML and CSS. You write clean, responsive markup without help.

data.subtitle: Build fast, scalable web experiences and AI-powered features across Arena's community platform products.
data.description:
About Arena

Arena is a startup created in Silicon Valley with a mission to build communities for creators, publishers and brands with the power of AI. Companies using Arena include Disney, Reuters, Fox, Red Bull and NFL. We have +2,000 customers in 150 countries, with +50M users engaging and having conversations on Arena every month.

We are a Series A company backed by top-tier investors such as CRV, Redpoint and Craft Ventures. Arena offers a unique work environment and the chance to collaborate with diverse teammates across multiple countries, with a culture of ownership, autonomy, and high performance.

Arena is expanding its AI product portfolio with MyAvatar.AI, a multimodal platform that enables users to create intelligent, personalized AI avatars through voice, video, and conversational interfaces.

We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to build fast, scalable, and high-performance web experiences across Arena’s products.

You’ll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build AI-powered features, improve existing applications, and solve complex frontend and performance challenges. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and have a direct impact on products used by millions of users.

What you will be doing

  • Build and maintain high-performance frontend applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Develop real-time experiences and interfaces using WebSockets and GraphQL.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components and frontend architecture.
  • Integrate frontend applications with APIs, AI services, and backend systems.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability across high-traffic environments.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to turn product requirements and UI/UX concepts into polished experiences.
  • Debug complex frontend and production issues and implement robust solutions.
  • Contribute to AI-powered features, including conversational experiences and AI Agents.

Must-Have Experience

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript and React.
  • Production experience with Next.js.
  • Experience working with GraphQL and REST APIs.
  • Experience building real-time applications using WebSockets.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows
  • Experience working in monorepo environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to performance, scalability, and code quality.
  • Fluent English

Our Stack

  • Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript.
  • UI: Web Components, CSS, Styled Components.
  • APIs & Real-Time: GraphQL, REST, WebSockets.
  • Build & Architecture: Monorepo, Turborepo, Webpack.
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Firebase, Firestore.
  • Design: Figma.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Styled Components or other CSS-in-JS solutions.
  • Turborepo, Webpack, or similar frontend tooling.
  • GitHub Actions and CI/CD workflows.
  • Node.js and backend development.
  • Firebase and Firestore.
  • Experience building browser extensions or WordPress plugins.
  • Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI Agents.

Example Projects You’ll Be Working on

  • Implement applications using Next.js framework
  • Build a real-time chat that can scale to 1M simultaneous users
  • Develop plugins for WordPress and Google Chrome
  • Implement high-performance widgets
  • Build a JavaScript SDK
  • Build and design AI features and AI agents

We also have some sweet perks like

  • 🔥 Be a part of the team in Silicon Valley and join a global team.
  • 💪 A team of exceptional engineers leading the cutting-edge AI Agents.
  • 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits.
  • ⛱️ 4 weeks of paid time-off.
  • 📖 Learning and Development budget.
  • 🚀 Key moment to join Arena in terms of growth and opportunities.
  • 💻 Ability to put your stamp on real-world AI applications that serve millions of users.
  • 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit.
  • 🌍 Multiple nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset.
  • 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Arena.

data.description:
Hi, I'm Juhi Banerjee, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG! We are excited to learn more about you and your unique background.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer II to join our team.

You should have a passion for technology and use it to solve business problems in a timely and reliable manner. Ability to work within a cross-functional Agile team to build and enhance core product/platform components in an iterative way. Close collaboration with product owners, QA, and other engineering functions to deliver well-tested, maintainable solutions.

In this role, you learn and apply professional engineering concepts. Work is reviewed periodically, and you typically receive general instruction on new assignments, while steadily increasing ownership and independence.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who will:

  • Software Development Engineers design, develop, test, and maintain software applications or systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create efficient and reliable software solutions, ensuring they meet project requirements and industry standards.
  • Debugging & Troubleshooting: Debug and fix software issues under guidance; participate in root-cause analysis and implement preventive improvements over time
  • Agile Delivery: Actively participate in sprint ceremonies, estimation, and team design discussions; communicate progress, risks, and blockers early
  • Operational Support: Work with support/implementation teams to investigate and resolve application issues in lower environments and production as needed, following team runbooks and escalation paths
  • Collaboration & Growth: Collaborate with senior/lead engineers to learn best practices (code reviews, secure coding, performance considerations, and maintainability).

Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience in .NET Core, C#, Angular, JavaScript, Azure DevOps, SQL server database.
  • Experience in one or more of the following (depending on CORE team stack):
  • Backend: C#/.NET, building services and APIs
  • Databases: MS SQL Server (or equivalent RDBMS), query tuning basics
  • Web Services: REST APIs, JSON; familiarity with IIS/ASP.NET is a plus (where applicable)
  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices
  • Version control (Git), code reviews, CI/CD concepts
  • Unit testing frameworks and test-driven habits
  • Agile/Scrum working model
  • Nice to have (CORE-friendly): cloud exposure (Azure/AWS), containers (Docker/Kubernetes), observability basics (logs/metrics/traces), performance tuning, AI tools experience like Cursor AI
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to work effectively within a team environment

CSGer Perks & Benefits

  • Work from Home
  • Employee Belonging Groups
  • Medical / Dental / Life Insurance
  • Meal Voucher
  • Paid Vacation, Volunteer, and Holiday Time Off
  • And so much more!

Location(s)

Brazil Remote; Colombia Remote

Accommodation

If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at +1 (402) 431-7440 or email us at accommodations@csgi.com. CSG provides accommodations for persons with disabilities in employment, including during the hiring process and any interview and/or testing processes.

Our Guiding Principles

Impact: Always help and empower others, whether they’re colleagues or customers. When our employees set their minds to something, great things happen.

Integrity: Do what’s right for our customers and our people while being authentic. We treat everyone with trust and respect—that’s just who we are.

Inspiration: Be bold in the way you think and passionate about the work you do. Test out innovative ideas without the fear of failure.

Our Story

CSG empowers companies to build unforgettable experiences, making it easier for people and businesses to connect with, use and pay for the services they value most. For over 40 years, CSG's technologies and people have helped some of the world's most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges and evolve to meet the demands of today's digital economy.

By channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Our people [CSGers] are fearlessly committed and connected, high on integrity and low on ego, making us the easiest company to do business with and the best place to work. We power a culture of integrity, innovation, and impact across our locations, representing the most authentic version of ourselves to build a better future together. That's just who we are.
